item.text: I’ll trace the SSH multiplexer and its existing protocol tests, record a checkpoint first, then implement prefix parsing and run the relevant test suite.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: support Teleport-Proxy-prefixed SSH connections in the SSH multiplexer.

Progress: locating the multiplexer and its existing protocol tests. No source changes made yet.
EOF
find . -name AGENTS.md -print; grep -RInE 'multiplex|Protocol.*SSH|SSH.*protocol|RemoteAddr\\(' --include='*.go' . | head -240"
